description: Attach child tickets to a parent ticket (CW's bundling). SERVICE tickets only. Children that already have a parent are refused rather than re-parented, and every child is read back afterwards so the result says which ones actually attached. NOT UNDOABLE FROM HERE — detaching a bundled ticket is only possible in the ConnectWise UI, so check the ids before calling.

child_ticket_ids.description: Tickets to attach to the parent

parent_ticket_id.description: The ticket the children are bundled under

response_format.description: Output format: human-readable markdown (default) or structured JSON

name: cw_bundle_tickets
title: Bundle ConnectWise Tickets Under a Parent
